{{Orphan|date=November 2021}}

In [[mathematics]], in the [[representation theory]] of [[Group (mathematics)|group]]s, a group is said to be '''representation rigid''' if for every <math>n</math>, it has only finitely many isomorphism classes of complex [[irreducible representation]]s of [[dimension]] <math>n</math>.
